flagged.evidence: The page says “no infinite-coproduct hypothesis can even be stated.” In the finite-dimensional module category, the countable family of zero modules has coproduct 0: for every Y, Hom_A(0,Y) and the product of countably many Hom_A(0,Y) are singletons. Preservation of existing coproducts is therefore a meaningful condition even though the countable coproduct of copies of A does not exist.
